name: Discrete Mathematics: Lemmora
subtitle: Logic, Proofs and Graph Theory
shortDescription: Adaptive discrete mathematics course with six 3D worlds: shortest paths, counting, Hanoi, toy RSA and a 4-bit adder. Chosen-length quizzes. Free to use.
longDescription:
Lemmora is an adaptive, interactive undergraduate discrete mathematics course: logic, proofs, counting, graphs and number theory.

### What you study
Propositional and predicate logic, sets and functions, proof techniques including induction, counting and combinatorics, recurrences, relations, graph theory, Boolean algebra and modular arithmetic.

### How it adapts
A personalised path that learns from your mistakes and schedules reviews, or the traditional syllabus order. Switch any time. Every wrong answer points to the habit behind it.

### Six 3D Worlds
Start from a real problem and explore it in 3D: a valley road map where Dijkstra's frontier glows outward and Kruskal's tree grows, city blocks whose lattice routes build a Pascal pyramid, a birthday party and the pigeonhole principle, a temple of discs for the Tower of Hanoi, a combination dial with a toy RSA lock, and a calculator chip with a 4-bit adder built from 20 gates. Each world shows live values and a second method that checks the answer, and opens its cited sources in an in-app window.

### Your Level, Your Length
Pick 5, 10, 20, 40 or your own number of questions, from beginner to research-level, adaptive or in course order. Mock exams stay ad-free.

### Practice and labs
Original problems with full worked solutions, typed-number and choice answers, unit checkpoints and timed mock exams, plus five interactive labs including a graph explorer where you search and drag the vertices.

### Sources you can open
Cited textbooks and university courses open in a clear source window with the licence and a link. Tap any concept for a plain-language refresher from earlier maths, with notes on what comes next.

Free to use. Ads appear only at natural breaks, never during a test, and every explanation stays free. An optional monthly plan removes ads. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any university or publisher named in the references.
